requirement: A new hypothesis must be explicitly stated before any research resumes.
Selection must explain why the hypothesis addresses prior failures and why alternatives are deferred.
Metrics, data scope, pass/caution/fail bands, no-trade comparison, and forbidden work must be frozen before testing.
Future active candidate must beat no-trade after fees and drawdown.
BTC-relevant hypotheses must compare to passive BTC benchmark over the same window.
BTCUSDT failure must remain visible and cannot be bypassed for BTC-relevant work.
If basket research resumes, weak markets must remain visible unless exclusions are predeclared and separately validated.
Any validation execution, data fetch, dry-run discussion, or bot operation requires separate explicit approval.
